scope: Native cylinder inventory and grouped radial-envelope diagnostics only; no new mesh generation or CAD modification.

new_regressions: One coarse previously omitted portion rejects its whole physical component
Missing inventory rows, missing selected frames and extra positive-overlap portions cannot pass
Below-guide stems remain in the inventory with explicit axial exclusions
Axial coverage holes, partial cylindrical bands, noncoaxial axes and unattributed components are rejected
Gmsh tags remapped to 9001-9008 preserve the native-face gate through the saved import bijection

historical_v1_preserved.reason_for_v2: The v1 four-face gate was explicitly local and omitted other axial portions of the same guides and stems. It must not be used as complete guide-passage coverage.

native_inventory.selection: Source component attribution plus native radius, coaxiality, full cylindrical-band verification and positive axial overlap beyond native boundary tolerance.
native_inventory.full_band_checks: BRep face validity, full 2pi angular span and native area versus 2pi*R*axial_length; numerical relative area tolerance 1e-9, no CAD tolerance changed.

explicit_exclusions.reason: Stem portions below the guides; endpoint-only overlap approximately 1.58e-12 within native boundary tolerance. Not asserted to be exactly disjoint.
Coaxial stem portions below the inner guides with no axial overlap.
Guide outer surfaces, native radius 5.5 rather than inner-guide radius 3.015.
All other native cylinders are retained in the private inventory and excluded by their native radii; they are not the 3.015/3.0 annular pair.

grouped_gate.bound: Maximum radial-envelope error over all guide portions plus maximum error over all stem portions of the same component, transformed into one common native axis frame.
grouped_gate.pure_API_triangle_dictionary_keys: Native face indices, never unconverted Gmsh entity tags

real_regression_on_previous_surface.interpretation: The complete eight-face gate correctly rejects the previous surface despite its four-face local pass. Negative conservative clearance bounds are not a direct penetration-depth measurement.

next_step_scope: Apply local sizing to all eight inventoried faces and their boundaries. Check grouped envelopes on the actual preserved surface and inspect remaining surface intersections before a separately authorized volume attempt.
